text: Germany, Austria and Switzerland have a strong club tradition. A Verein is a registered club, and there are hundreds of thousands of them: football and choir, hiking and chess, volunteer fire brigades and allotment gardens. Many people belong to at least one.

A club usually has a small annual fee (der Mitgliedsbeitrag) and fixed training times. It is a normal way to meet people in a new town. Many Language Centre learners say that joining one is the quickest way to practise German.
